summary: Iteration 3 testing — refined enquiry forms, quote modal, and packages section. Updated /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py to include new required `name` field; all 10 backend tests pass. Executed Playwright coverage for all 11 requested frontend/integration scenarios on desktop (1440x800) and mobile (390x844). All critical flows pass: 5-field hero form (no email), hero-form submit persists name='Rahul Sharma' package='Custom Bali Trip', package Get Quote buttons produce exact dialog titles for cards 0..3, Honeymoon modal submit stores package='Bali Honeymoon', packages-custom-quote-btn present (text 'Can't find your trip? Get a Custom Quote'), 'View All Packages' removed, custom-quote submit persists package='Custom Bali Trip', header CTA opens 'Get Your Custom Bali Quote' even after a package dialog, modal is 640px wide with badge/title/description/inputs/submit/WhatsApp all sharing left edge x=432, submit and WhatsApp widths equal (576px), close button top-right visible and closes dialog, no floating-enquire-btn on desktop (scroll 1500px), mobile-sticky-bar present at 390px, all 4 package cards equal height (560.4px), Family card shows 'per person' + 'Starting from', no 'per family' anywhere on page, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: WHATSAPP_NUMBER is empty placeholder in /app/frontend/src/lib/constants.ts — intentional per request but means WhatsApp CTAs link to wa.me/ (invalid). Should be set before production.
backend/server.py: EmailStr import unused (email field optional and not used by UI).
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is a FastAPI/Starlette anti-pattern; browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origins.
seed_data_creation: Three test leads created via UI: name='Rahul Sharma' pkg='Custom Bali Trip'; name='TEST_Honeymoon User' pkg='Bali Honeymoon'; name='TEST_Custom User' pkg='Custom Bali Trip'. Backend pytest also created TEST_* leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses required name (min_length=2), default package='Custom Bali Trip'. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py updated with name field. UI selectors: lead-* (hero) and modal-* (dialog). Select triggers: click then click option with data-testid lead-month-option / lead-travelers-option (and modal-* equivalents). On mobile, package card quote buttons require horizontal scroll of the packages-grid (cards use snap carousel with min-w-[82%]).
